title: Public Grant Ledger
creator: feitianbf
summary: BSD-3-Clause Rust reconciliation tool and hosted read-only reviewer. It compares approved payments with archived receipts, flags discrepancies and duplicate payments, and exports evidence-linked CSV rows. November 18, 2026: both official Ootle mainnet catalogues list its PublicGrant template at 098accfc8e69ea08ea14e676ad0973fc1ccd6f3d8f677d5bb4cfc144049562b0, epoch 38890, with matching binary hash and author key. This confirms published template code, not an executed grant payment. The creator’s demo distinguishes archived mainnet auction/escrow receipts from local-engine grant samples labeled local_demo. The transaction-proof endpoint returned HTTP 403 in this review; that receipt was not independently verified. The refreshed recording shows the current Chinese-language README and its deployment/sample boundaries. No wallet, signing or template execution was performed.
cardSummary: Compare approved payments with archived transaction receipts, flag discrepancies and duplicate entries, and export evidence-linked reconciliation rows.
